sessions.title: Live sessions
sessions.description: Every signed-in session in this organisation. Killing a session signs that device out immediately.
sessions.confirmBody: {name} will be signed out on that device straight away and must log in again.

history.title: Login history
history.description: Recent sign-in events from the audit log, newest first.
history.limitation: Failed sign-ins are recorded per attempt only when the email matches an account; attempts with unknown emails are not recorded.

locked.title: Locked accounts
locked.description: Active accounts that are locked now or have recent failed sign-ins.
locked.failures: {count, plural, one {# failed attempt} other {# failed attempts}}
locked.confirmBody: The failed-attempt counter and lock for {name} will be cleared.

reset.title: Password-reset link
reset.description: Create a single-use reset link for a user. No email is sent: you hand the link over yourself.
reset.once: The link is shown once and cannot be retrieved later. Creating a new link cancels the older one.
reset.confirmBody: Create a single-use reset link for this user?
reset.shownOnce: Copy it now. It will not be shown again.
reset.warn: Valid until {time}. Anyone with this link can set the password.
reset.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the link and copy it manually.

audit.title: Developer audit trail
audit.description: Actions taken in the Developer Panel, newest first.
